replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
In my opinion, the water in the middle needs to be replaced with another type of block. It will be so annoying when constantly being hit into the water, and making it a pain to try and get out. Not to mention Demo would be SO destructive!
The team spawns are a tad too close to the control point, as python + popper can easily get there within a matter of seconds. I am not saying you should drag the spawn 100 blocks out, but to an extent where there is some time to reward players who are aiming for the objective. 

Otherwise, I feel like this is an interesting map, nice work!

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
I'm sorry, But the judges for the map building contest have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

- Water in Isle de Tropical is too large in quantity. Removing water, or creating a better and more successful way of walking across the water in this map, would increase quality of gameplay greatly.

Aesthetics -  3/5
Gameplay - 2/5 
Creativity -  2/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
